description: This file provides factory functions for creating checkpointer instances with default configurations, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous modes. It handles distributed environment detection, component initialization, and configuration management for checkpointing in distributed PyTorch setups.

classes.name: SyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Synchronous checkpointer class for saving and loading checkpoints.

classes.name: AsyncCheckpointer
classes.description: Asynchronous checkpointer class allowing non-blocking checkpoint operations.

classes.name: CheckpointProcess
classes.description: Handles the process of checkpointing asynchronously.

classes.description: Default staging class managing checkpoint staging area.

classes.name: RankInfo
classes.description: Data class containing distributed rank information.
